## Professional Profile

Experienced in architecting resilient web platforms, vector databases, real-time messaging, and high-performance serverless backends.

## Core Technical Proficiencies
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Python, Go, Rust, SQL, HTML5/CSS3.

- AI & Machine Learning: Groq API (Llama 3.3), OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Embeddings (Qdrant, pgvector), RAG Architectures.

## Featured Production Projects
- **NeuroFlow Distributed Inference Engine**: High-throughput distributed inference orchestration layer for open-weight LLMs utilizing dynamic request batching, KV-cache optimization, and zero-downtime routing.
- **HyperScale Cloud Vector DB**: Sub-millisecond vector indexing and similarity search engine built on custom HNSW clustering algorithms with automatic sharding and replication.
- **PulseOS Real-Time Kernel Monitor**: Real-time distributed telemetry dashboard capturing micro-kernel metrics, memory bandwidth allocation, and network jitter using WebSockets and Canvas rendering.
- **Aether UI Design System**: Framework-agnostic, zero-dependency modern component design system built with CSS Custom Properties, semantic HTML, and precision accessibility standards.
